deductions: Every finite continuation branch with growthO(|t-c|^(delta-1)log^N),delta>0,remains subpolar after every polynomial ramification. Finite contour transports and residue additions preserve this property,including infinite density monodromy.

A rational Cauchy infinity germ has no finite poles under that hypothesis and tends0 at infinity,hence is zero. Finite sums,polynomial tilts and affine mixtures retain the conclusion;nonzero total mass excludes eventual polynomial-phase moment vanishing in ALL degrees.

Two independent beta variables with arbitrary positive real parameters have an explicit hypergeometric product density. All continuation exponents are a-1,c-1 at0 and b+d-1,0 at1,so every polynomial phase is excluded.

The actual octahedral sphere seedH=27a2b2c2 has the same compact moment sequence as Beta(1/2,1/3)*Beta(1/2,2/3),hence density(3sqrt(t))^-1*2F1(1/3,2/3;1;1-t). Its equation has finite exponents-1/2,-1/2 and0,0;the nonzero logarithm makes the density nonalgebraic.

The original left-T-invariant Hopf coordinates give matrix degree12 forH,with nonzero rank-one leading form. Thus only0 is pure in the entire original octahedral subalgebraC[H],covering unbounded matrix degrees12degp. No general2O or2I decision follows.
essential_boundaries: All branches of the actual density continuation space must be checked,not just the physical interval branch. -log(1-t)/t is physically integrable but continuation around1 adds a pole at0.
Neither arbitrary holonomicity nor regular singularity alone supplies exponents>-1. A large annihilating system can include unused bad solutions;actual continuation subspace matters.
No actual general Haar density is assumed to meet the hypotheses. The octahedral coordinate-product seed is proved to do so;the icosahedral group does not preserve that seed.
Universal contour transport,growth estimates,probability density identification and group application are internal written proofs;the checker supplies only selected symbolic controls.
